errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the purpose of the chart. The chart title asks about the competence of cybersecurity personnel, not whether users have experience interacting with them.
The chart shows data for five categories with responses, not four. The categories are 'Да, напълно', 'Не мога да преценя', 'Не, изобщо', 'По-скоро да', and 'По-скоро не'.
The list of x-axis categories is incomplete and incorrect. It omits the category with the highest value, 'По-скоро да', and the category with the lowest value, 'Не, изобщо'.
The description incorrectly transcribes the category labels. The correct labels are 'Не мога да преценя;' and 'Не, изобщо;'.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps values to categories. The value 1 corresponds to 'Не, изобщо', not 'Не може да преценя' (which has a value of 40). The value 43 corresponds to 'По-скоро да', not 'Не, обично' (a misspelling of 'Не, изобщо').
Due to incorrect mappings, the description completely omits the data point for 'Не мога да преценя', which has a value of 40 (the second highest bar).
